entry.title: Yakuza Gaiden v0.8.0
entry.content:
## Update notes, and goals for the next build
More fun mythology before the patch notes, first a recap:
I name the builds based all around the myth of the carp climbing the waterfall to become a dragon, because c'mon this is a yakuza randomizer! We started with varieties of fish pre AP integration, then moved to monstrous fish, or dragon fish, since. And on release will likely move to dragon names!
This one is named Namazu, which is named after a large catfish monster whose thrashing would cause violent earthquakes across Japan, until eventually restrained by a god. Chosen due to the earthquake like effects of migrating everything to exist within the AP world rather than needing multiple files. We finally got everything wrapped up into one file! the earthquakes are no more!
Less massive of a release than last time, no real major features within the rando have been added this build. As the goal here was to make a ton of Quality of Life changes like combining the text client with the game console!
There are still logic changes and bug fixes included however, so it should be a better experience overall.
Next version will focus on actual new functionality for the rando itself, maybe bringing in some existing features from other mods like the enemy randomizer mod or incorporating a way to adjust world events for new progression and cooler locked items... but nothing for sure yet!
That being said, there's no better time to play then now! Every build gets a bit more efficient, clean, and fun. So like always, if you test it out and have an issue, please reach out to me either through discord, submitting an issue through Github, or make a post on the AP Afterdark page for Gaiden.
The new code is stored in the Archipelago branch which has existed since early on, but the releases will stay here for keeping things consistent for archival. Here is a link to that Github in case you want to see the new code:
https://github.com/zorasknight/Archipelago
## Yakuza Gaiden Randomizer Version 0.8.0 (Namazu)
- There is no longer a separate Yakuza Gaiden Randomizer, it is now baked into the Yakuza Gaiden AP World Client! This means I highly recommend re-reading the Readme to understand the new installs going forward. - A standard Text Client has been created for Yakuza Gaiden! This allows you to handle all the normal bits and bobs through the custom text client rather than using the console. including connecting, hinting, releasing etc. I recommend having the client connected before starting the game so that the console can auto connect using the information. - You can now double click on your slot name to launch the Gaiden text client and auto connect to the slot. - Full Universal Tracker Support built in, which does still mean you need to download the universal tracker ap world, but assuming you have that already (I recommend updating to the most recent build!) you should have access to the tracker map for each region as well as all the newer bells and whistles that it includes. - Full Map Tracking included with the universal tracker! This took quite a bit of time, but you should now have access to a map tracker so long as you have universal tracker installed. - YAML-Less support for Universal Tracker, You no longer need to make sure the correct player yaml is in your players folder, universal tracker will collect the information you need from your slot information! - Logic bug fixes for random tasks, substories, and some pocket circuit logic fixes - Hints added for substories on accepting them to decide whether pursuing them is worth it - Hint fixes for tasks to catch some loose fetch and trial tasks - YAML fixes for minigame keys - Setting fixes in general for better stability - PC car fixes to make sure every slot in a rando seed has unique parts distributed - Many small stability fixes for the client

entry.title: Creeper World 4 v0.2.1
entry.content:
Matched pair: install the plugin zip AND regenerate with this `cw4.apworld`. The plugin and the apworld share a version number and must match.
Requires Archipelago **0.6.7 or newer**.
**Existing yamls keep working**, and a yaml that names no new setting means what it meant before. Seeds do change: a solo or all-Creeper-World-4 seed number generates a different layout than it did in v0.2.0, because the early weapon is now actually placed early.
- **Fixed: `early_weapon` did nothing when every player was Creeper World 4**, solo included, from v0.1.3 to v0.2.0. The option asks Archipelago to place the chosen weapon - and a second mission unlock - in the checks you can reach with nothing. But on those seeds the world places its own progression first, so it can retry where Archipelago's fill would give up, and it took both items out of the pool before Archipelago looked for them. Nothing warned. Measured over 10,000 solo seeds: the chosen weapon came first on 38 percent of them, the early unlock on 11. The world now places both itself, first. - **Fixed: in a multiworld with other games, a narrow opening asked for nothing early.** Casual logic at 2 starters, or a SPAN draw with only one check open at the start, stood its requests down for a bootstrap that only runs when every player is Creeper World 4. 13 to 48 percent of CW4 players in those multiworlds got neither. They now get the requests. When only one check is open, the mission unlock gets it. - **Measured, not assumed.** A new tool, `tools/audit/earlysweep.py`, generates through the same path a player's seed takes and checks where the items actually LAND. 10,000 seeds in each of seven shapes - solo, two and four CW4 players, and CW4 beside ChecksFinder, VVVVVV, Meritous and Timespinner: 0 generation failures, 0 unreachable or unbeatable seeds, and the weapon and the unlock early in every one that asked. As a side effect the world's own fill now has to retry 7 to 20 times less often. - **Placements change.** A solo or all-CW4 seed number generates a different layout than it did in v0.2.0, and so does a mixed multiworld whose CW4 opening is narrow; any other mixed multiworld is unchanged. `tools/span-off-parity.sh` and `tools/refactor-parity.sh` report the difference, by design. - **The yaml is short now.** `Creeper World 4.yaml` used to be the template Archipelago generates, 635 lines of its own boilerplate and of notes written for whoever maintains the world. It is now written by hand, 120 lines: each option at its default with a line or two on what it does and the values it takes, in the order of the options page - Archipelago's own progression balancing and accessibility first, as in its official template, then the goal and logic, traps, energy upgrades and ERNs. The descriptions on the options page are rewritten for players as well; the design notes moved into the code. - **New: `logic_difficulty: easy`.** Casual asks for a Sniper OR a Missile Launcher from We Were Never Alone (mission 6) onward. Easy asks the same until The Experiment (mission 13) - the designer's "small spike in map difficulty", where the worksheet calls snipers, missiles and a cannon over a mortar all worth having - and from there all four of Sniper, Missile Launcher, Cannon and Mortar. Like casual it counts by story number, so every SPAN map gets all four, and it gates every check on those missions except the free caches. The in-game tracker needs no update: it reads the requirements from the seed, so a check missing one of the four shows yellow. Measured over 21,000 seeds in seven multiworld shapes - solo, two and four CW4 players, and CW4 beside one to four other games: 0 generation failures, and the early weapon still lands early. - **Four options that do nothing are hidden** from the options page and the yaml: `trap_weight_emitter_overdrive` and the three `filler_*_weight` options. A yaml that still names them generates as before.

entry.title: Librarian Tidy Up the Arcane Library v3.0.0
entry.content:
# Librarian-AP v3.0.0
# Choose how books arrive, and what earns a check
How books reach you and what earns a check are now two settings, `unlock_mode` and `check_mode`, and every pairing works. One exception: `individual_book_unlocks` with `series` checks is switched to booksanity, since 3,072 items cannot sit in 400 row checks.
**2.x YAMLs do not carry over: regenerate your template.** `unlock_mode: booksanity` is now `unlock_mode: individual_book_unlocks` with `check_mode: booksanity`. A 2.0.3 run in progress keeps working on 3.0.0.
## New
- **`unlock_mode: random_book_bundle`**: each bundle hands you the next `books_per_bundle` books, drawn from anywhere in the library. `numbered_book_bundles` makes each one its own item (host must allow it). - **`check_mode: count`**: a `Shelved N Books` check every `check_interval` correctly shelved books. Taking a book off a shelf takes it off the count. - **Numbered series bundles**: `Series Bundle 3` and so on, so you can hint the one you want. - **`bookcase_unlocks`**: bookcases open one at a time, a section at a time, or all at once. - **`magic_skills_enabled`**: leave out any magic skill, with its Mastery and Fatigue. - **`count_bundle_preference`**: with book bundles and count checks, pick whether the bundle size or the check interval gives way. - **The game's real ending**: reaching your goal opens the way to the library door. Use it to play the ending and send the goal; otherwise it sends on its own after five minutes, with a reminder each minute. - **Universal Tracker**: `/get_logical_path` names the bundle behind any book or row check. - **F8** writes a report of every section to the log, and the HUD shows a summary. - **Count checks name a book that does not count**: a book left in a wrong slot, or on another section's shelf, is named on the HUD until it moves. - **Out-of-order full rows** are named on the HUD. - **Books that spawn on a shelf** land on the floor in front of it when revealed. - **One log file per launch** in `Mods\Librarian-AP\logs\`. - **Host settings** in `host.yaml`: `allow_individual_book_unlocks` and `allow_numbered_book_bundles`, for the two shapes that are slow to generate. - **Grouped options** in the template and the web options page. - **The connect shortcut is now F9**, not F12, which Steam uses for screenshots.
## Fixes since 2.0.3
- Assemble no longer pulls locked books into your bag, only for the mod to take them straight back out. - "Correctly shelve N books", Section Complete, Floor Complete and a book-counted custom goal could fire from locations other players collected in your world. They now count only books and rows actually on your shelves. - A Reached Level check could wait for the next load. Levels now read the bookcases. - A custom goal under booksanity showed its progress in rows; it now counts books. - A save the mod refused could still send the goal; it now follows the same rule as checks. - A refused save says what to do. If only its book layout differs from the run's last save, F7 accepts it. - With every AP save slot in use, a new run could overwrite one of your saves; it now refuses and says which to delete. - The connect window no longer collapses on some screens, and reopening it with F4 fills in your saved server and slot again. - Green ghost books no longer show on every shelf. - Row checks send as soon as a swap lands, not up to 12 seconds later. - The HUD no longer shows bare location numbers (`→ loc 1910133`) for some checks. - Universal Tracker now matches seeds with `series_per_unlock` of 3 and custom goals.
## Updating
> Extract the zip and drop `Librarian/` into your Steam install (overwrite). Drop > `librarian.apworld` into your Archipelago `custom_worlds/` folder. **Both are > required.** The title screen should read `LibAP v3.0.0`.
## If something breaks
Press F8, then send that session's log from `Mods\Librarian-AP\logs\`, your YAML's `Librarian:` section, and one line on what you were doing.

entry.title: Cobalt Core v1.2.2
entry.content:
Took a short break from game development to make a small update. I know they are few and far between, but I'm always paying attention!
# New Features
- CAT now has proper reactions to received Deathlinks. Thanks again to Mufflebuns for writing and designing these! - Added the `additional_traps` YAML option to, well, add traps. The generator will add as many cards/artifacts to compensate for the item amount. - Added the `forced_starting_cards` YAML option, which allows you to force, in part or in full, which cards each character starts with. Works in tandem with `randomize_starting_cards`. - The progress screen at the end of a run now show you AP progress bars, instead of the Codex like in vanilla. - Added some SFX/VFX feedback to AP cards. I didn't like that they just disappeared into the ether, checking a location should feel good! - Upgrades to AP cards are now character-dependent. - I'm looking for feedback on the balancing of these, as well as the idea itself in general.
# Tweaks
- Reworked how the goal is defined. - Removed `win_condition`: it is now deduced from the other options. - `memories_required_total` and `memories_required_per_character` can now be active at the same time for a mixed goal. - Added `characters_required`, defining how many characters need to have the amount of memories defined by `memories_required_per_character`, if you only want to use 7 characters for example. - Removed `add_character_memories`, it is now forced on. This is easier for me to manage and the off state is covered by `characters_required`. - Added the `unlocked_card_boot_option` and `unlocked_artifact_boot_option` YAML options, which define whether and how you can pick unlocked items at the start of a run, instead of having a single predefined behavior. - `unlocked_artifact_boot_option` can be set to `limited`, which means you only get to pick 1 of 8 random artifacts. - `pick_missed_items_from_every_run` is now `seen_items_at_shop`, with more granular settings. - `starting_characters` has been renamed to `forced_starting_characters` to better reflect its behavior. - The generator will now guarantee that a second ship can be found early on. - The connection info screen now has helpful tooltips for its various buttons and text fields. - Added the `super_secret_special_cards` option, to deactivate them if you want to (particularly in asyncs) - I may or may not have added a new one of those. I'm sorry. It will happen again
# Fixes
- Fixed an extremely rare issue where generation could fail if you started with solo CAT. - Added some logs to hopefully catch some of the elusive mysterious bugs I've been seeing if they happen again in the future.
The APWorld and YAML options must both be updated.

entry.title: Ys Origin v1.9.2r2
entry.content:
> 🧪 **Still a beta.** Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**. > > ⚠️ **Copy all three files, and start a fresh seed.** Two item names changed meaning (Ruby and Topaz, see below), so a beta 5 seed won't line up with this apworld. Players mid-run on a beta 5 seed can still take the **DLL** alone: it brings every mod-side fix below except the Roda Fruit one, which needs a seed from this apworld. > > The mod fixes in this beta were reviewed and built, but **not yet played in-game**. Please report anything odd.
See [beta 1](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.1) for the full 2.0 change list. Everything since then is included.
## 🔥⚡ Torches need fire, cracked walls need thunder
Some gates are not in any script: the engine itself makes a torch ignore everything but fire and a crumbling wall ignore everything but thunder. Every room's object table was scanned for these, and the logic now requires what the game requires:
- **Flooded Prison 8F:** the wall hiding the **Arthropod Medallion** chest and the wall on the way up to the Roo both need the **Levinstrike Warhammer**. The red Menoaks holding the barrier shrug off weapons and wind, so that barrier needs thunder or fire. - **Flames of Guilt 11F:** the far side of the moving-platform room (its second chest, and the way on to 12F) needs the **Crimson Lotusblade** and the **Cerulean Flabellum**. - **Flames of Guilt 12F:** the **Construct Medallion** chest needs the Lotusblade for its four torches. - **Silent Sands 15F:** the cracked wall on the way to the **Creeper Medallion** needs the Warhammer.
Before this, a seed could put the Warhammer or the Lotusblade behind the very wall or torch it opens.
## 💎 Ruby and Topaz were the wrong way round
The gem called Ruby upgraded thunder and the one called Topaz upgraded fire. The names now match the game: **Topaz is thunder, Ruby is fire**. Nothing else about them changed.
## ⚙️ Options
- **Progressive elemental skills are always on.** The first one you find is the skill itself, the next three are its upgrades. The option is gone from the template; old yamls still load. - **Random start now turns Statue warp locks on by itself.** Without them the mod never warped you to your spawn, while the logic assumed it had. - Finding a Cleria Ore upgrades your weapon whatever `weapon_requirements` is set to (it always did; the option only controls whether zones wait for it).
## 🛠️ Mod fixes
- **Thrown back to your start statue at the summit.** Loading a save and walking into the Tower Summit triggered the New Game spawn warp once. Fixed. - **Reconnects no longer hand out extra tiers.** Progressive Armor, Boots, skills and blessings moved up a tier every time the connection dropped and came back. - **Items sent while you were at the title screen are no longer lost.** SP, Celcetan Panaceas, blessing effects and skill levels were written before your save loaded, then overwritten by it. They now wait until you are in the game. - **Per-seed saves work without touching the config.** The default file pattern never matched the game's save files, so every seed shared one set of saves unless you had set `save_pattern=.bin` yourself. That is now the default. - **Roda Fruit can't be wasted.** The Roos can be fed in any order, and feeding a late one first could leave an early one (that the logic had promised you) without its fruit. The mod now keeps your fruit count at "Roos still unfed among the ones you have fruits for", so that can't happen. - **Switching rooms from the F8 menu** no longer carries over the previous seed's locked statues and suppressed items. - **No more repeated "Found" toasts** for old checks after a reconnect or on re-entering a room, and a statue purchase no longer reports twice. - **F9** (manual spawn warp) only works while the game window has focus.
## Known issues
- Some vanilla "you got it!" dialogue still plays when the real item is elsewhere (for example the Evil Ring charging).

Major Changes/Additions: - added deathlink (toggled ingame) with support for grouped deathlink - added map configs for Half-Life 2s chapter "Anticitizen One" - Location entities will now have particles on them based on what flags the item placed on them has, hinted locations also get an icon above them signifying the hint status - a new YAML option called `trap_vision` can be used to control whether these particles should show up on trap items - The ingame tracker now has a separate tab that shows all hints for the current slot, similar to the one in the generic text client - Unlike the generic text client, it will only show items that have actually been loaded when trying to hint for items - Locations can also be hinted from the regular tracker tab - added a new menu that can be used to add keybinds that will only be used in the apAdventure gamemode or only for the current run - configs will now store the map revision number of the current map when saved and use it to check if there's a mismatch if the config needs it - added some HL2-themed trap items - added Upsets Half-Life 1 SWEPs as an alternate weapon set (requires Half-Life: Source or Half-Life Deathmatch: Source) - also included a new preset that uses them - added a Stalker Scream trap (blacklisted by default) (I wasn't going to add this at first, but [someone asked for it.](https://discord.com/channels/1085716850370957462/1492516400747778159/1545388855702855680)) - Item definitions can now have a bunch of fields on them to control what flags the created item will have assigned to them - Added the `custom_parameters` YAML option, which can be used with the cparam node in access rules and accessed through the `APADV_CUSTOMPARAMS` global in lua to allow map configs and item sets to have their own YAML options - some hl2 configs now use a parameter called `hl2_enable_janky_backtracks` that needs to be enabled to allow some of the jankier backtracking routes to be added to your run - the condition selectors in the region editor and the access editor ui for the cparam node now display icons next to different conditions to help users tell what game certain ammo types are from - the RedeemCheck field in an item definition for a OneUse item can now be set to `true` instead of a function to have the Redeem function itself return if an item should count as redeemed or not instead of the RedeemCheck function - added GravityGun to capab node presets - added some basic code to the gamemodes ShouldCollide hook to allow for easy custom collision filters - this is currently only used to make everything that is not a player not collide with exit entities - added a `test_mode` YAML option, which can be used to disable some gamemode restrictions for testing purposes - tweaked capabilities on some hl2 weapons - tracker window now refuses to open when tracker data hasn't been received yet to prevent people from seeing a broken-looking tracker - the apworld will now also see logic data inside gmod addon folders to make installing custom content more straightforward - added a guide with information about packing custom content - the gamemode now sets the console variables `ai_ignoreplayers 0` and `npc_citizen_auto_player_squad 1` on initialization - the base lua files for item sets can now set the functions `OnLoad` and `OnUnload` to have code run when an itemset is loaded or unloaded - pass requirement checking functions a copy of the `engine.GetGames()` table that's been converted to use the folder fields as keys - added a requirement tag that checks if hl:s or hldm:s is mounted - reduced the requirements on the grenade access rule in d1_town_05 to ShortArcProjectile, removed the handplaced grenades since the map already has a crate that's guaranteed to give grenades nearby - the warnings shown for inaccessible access rules have been changed - the inaccessible_warning yaml option now needs to be enabled for these to be written to the warning log - will now also show up on inaccessible locations, entrances and exits, instead of just internal connections (idk why this was the case i never did this before, this seems like a very obvious thing to add in hindsight) - warnings will now also show the actual json data from the access rule, as well as the conditions from the region it was placed on - wrote a guide with information about packing custom content - itemset base lua files can now have a function run when the itemset is loaded and/or unloaded - added option groups for yaml options - added a new yaml option called `filler_weight_override` that allows the fill weight for filler items to be overridden
Fixes/Minor Changes: - fixed an issue where players could be placed inside a trigger_changelevel before it was removed, causing an immediate map change - added a check if the tracker has been loaded before querying it since some people reported lua errors stemming from this - made the gamemode auto-disconnect from AP if the server doesn't send it the run id - most GMod code files now use tabs for indentation to reduce file size + removed a bunch of unnecessary whitespace - some obsolete variables were removed - fixed an issue where the last remaining two-way connection would not be split properly, which could cause generation errors - short item names were removed from the datapackage for now (I intended to have the gamemode automatically use these unless there's a conflict, but never got around to implementing it, removing it for now to not bloat the DataPackage too much.) - the APADV_SAVEID global is now updated sooner so it's more consistent for functions that may get called in config scripts - fixed the tracker not properly reloading the ammomerge table if it was loaded from a previously saved .json - fixed the lua file containing the requirements ui not being AddCSLuaFile'd - changed the wording of one of the install instruction to prevent potential confusion - when loading configs, check if entities that have been marked for deletion by their map creation id are valid to prevent lua errors - check if the dupedata table is valid before running duplicator.Paste - fixed the spawnmenu not actually working while sv_cheats is enabled like it's supposed to - fixed the spawnpoint model being in the wrong folder because of a typo in the .qc - changed the `apadv_apsay` console command to only to only pass the first argument instead of the entire argstring, since this could cause it to mangle chat commands - removed some unnecessary debug prints - fixed the `apadv_loadcfg` concommand checking the wrong folder to detect if a configs exists, which meant it could only be used without arguments to reload the current config, renamed it from `apadventure_loadcfg` to be consistent with other gamemode concommands - make config script item handlers run after OnFullConnect - fixed the tracker breaking if a config tries to make a connection to a non-existing region, now throws a non-halting error instead - made the error displayed when locations that aren't present in the datapackage are detected after receiving full data more informative - fixed condition overrides not being included in the regconds set, which meant that some items would not end up being classified as progression items when they should - fixed `host.yaml` still being mentioned in the setup guide - removed hoverhint on the labels in the connection UI since OnCursorEntered doesn't actually work on labels - fixed the map list in the file manager not displaying if a map has both a static and local config - fixed implied capabilities not being properly applied to items for the ingame tracker, which caused some things to be considered as inaccessible when they shouldn't - fixed the "Copy Tag" option given when right-clicking a requirement tag in the config editors requirements list not actually doing anything - fixed a mistake in the requirement ui help text - fixed a bunch of clientside lua files not being AddCSLuaFile'd - un-capitalized some words in option descriptions that probably shouldn't be capitalized
If you don't know what the .fgd file is for, you don't need it.
# Important If you had an old version of the gmod addon installed, delete the old folder before installing the new one, some parts of the file system have changed. If you have made some custom content for apAdventure and put it into the apAdventure addon folder, check out [the packing custom content guide](https://github.com/ChrisCj8/ap_adventure/blob/main/apworld/docs/packing_custom_content_en.md) for information about how to pack your stuff so you won't lose it in the future.
Also, you most likely won't be able to finish any old runs you've already started with this version, so finish those before updating.

Players mid-run on a beta 6 seed can still take the **DLL** alone. > > The mod changes in beta 6 and beta 7 were reviewed and built, but **not yet played in-game**. Please report anything odd.
See [beta 1](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.1) for the full 2.0 change list and [beta 6](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.6) for the fire and thunder gates. Everything since then is included.

Zeruenas, Karons, Zarues, Bazeraenas and Zelkarons get back up unless the Silver Chimes are equipped. Two barriers in the tower are held by them. The Zarue pit on 15F was already in the logic; the other was not:

Checked against the walkthrough for all three characters:
- **Corrupted Blood 18F:** the spike-and-gate room right after the statue takes three double-jumps. Going past it now needs the **Gold Bracelet**. Before this, a seed could send you into Corrupted Blood without it. - **Demonic Core 22F:** the Roda Fruit chest across the gap needs the **Gold Bracelet** and the **Cerulean Flabellum**. The last Roo needs the **Gold Bracelet**. - **Flames of Guilt 10F:** the Roda Fruit chest needs the **Mask of Eyes** (the hidden bridge leads to the switch that raises its platform).

- **Catch-up EXP now defaults to 60** (it was 20, the same as the base rate, so it did nothing). Levels ramp steeply from 18F and a player on pace at 17F was falling a dozen levels behind. Set it equal to `exp_multiplier_base` if you want one flat rate.

- **"You got it!" when you didn't.** When a story scene hands over an item that the randomizer has moved (the Zelkarons charging the Evil Ring, for example), the dialogue still plays. The feed now tells you the game's own copy was withheld and yours comes from the multiworld. - **`!alias` no longer confuses the toasts.** Your own items showed as someone else's and popped twice once you had set an alias. - The weapon upgrade can no longer be re-applied on the title screen, and a few things the network thread shared with the game thread (the log file, item colours, blessing grants) are now properly guarded.

- Used medallions, keys and Moon Crests come back into the inventory after use. The doors they opened stay open; it is cosmetic.

entry.title: Ys Origin v2.0.0
entry.content:
Everything since **1.9.2**: seven betas' worth of changes in one release. Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**.
> ⚠️ **Copy all three files and start a fresh seed.** Locations, items and logic all changed since 1.9.2; an old seed will not line up with this apworld. > > **What has and hasn't been played.** Betas 1 to 5 were played by the community. The mod changes added in beta 6, beta 7 and this release (marked 🆕 below, including autosave) were reviewed and built but have **not been played in-game yet**. If autosave misbehaves, set `autosave_slot=0` in `yso_ap.cfg`. Please report anything odd, with `yso_ap_mod.log` from `%TEMP%`.
Huge thanks to everyone who reported and tested: **CRIT MAGNET**, **Shiro** (`cain1111`), **Gravagar**, **Chiral**, **Ultima Solus**, **HothRaka** and everyone on Discord 💚
---
## 🗺️ Room logic rebuilt from the game's own data
In 1.9.2 the room-to-room logic was mostly hand-written from maps and a walkthrough, and much of it was wrong. Every zone has been rebuilt from the game's exit tables, its room scripts, its object tables and its enemy data.
- **Wailing Blue:** the 4-statue barrier and the Blue Necklace. Toal needs the **Bronze Key** (which leads to Boost) instead of the necklace. - **Flooded Prison:** 17 of 25 rooms were wrong. The **Arthropod Medallion** now guards the door to Nygtilger. **Water Dragon's Scales** are required only where the water is always deep. - **Flames of Guilt:** 20 of 27 rooms were wrong. Gelaldy is behind the **Construct Medallion** door. The 11F noise room is gated: Hugo needs the **Hammer**, Yunica the **Silver Harmonica** and the Flames Roo's song, Toal walks it on Boost. - **Silent Sands:** almost entirely rewritten, with the Marble Key, Amber Key, Creeper Medallion, Earth Dragon's Claws, Silver Chimes and Gold Bracelet on the doors, slopes and ledges they actually guard. Rado's Annex door needs the **Evil Ring** and the **Blue Necklace**. - **Corrupted Blood:** the Crimson Key, Dragonbone Key and Mantid Medallion doors are in their real places, and the pits are one-way. - **Demonic Core:** the **Rod** gates the mirror maze (it wasn't required at all before). The win is reaching the summit through the **Devil Medallion** door.
### Gates no script shows
- **🔥⚡ Torches need fire, cracked walls need thunder.** The engine makes them ignore everything else. 8F: the wall hiding the Arthropod Medallion chest and the wall before the Roo need the **Levinstrike Warhammer**; the red Menoaks' barrier needs thunder or fire. 11F: the far side of the moving-platform room needs the **Crimson Lotusblade** and the **Cerulean Flabellum**. 12F: the Construct Medallion chest needs the Lotusblade. 15F: the wall on the way to the Creeper Medallion needs the Warhammer. - **🔔 Undead barriers need the Silver Chimes.** 20F: the Zeruenas' barrier in front of the **Dragonbone Key** chest (and the story scene Yunica's 1F Dreaming Idol check waits on). - **🦘 Double-jumps.** 18F's spike-and-gate room needs the **Gold Bracelet**. The 22F Roda Fruit chest needs the Gold Bracelet and the Flabellum; the last Roo needs the Gold Bracelet. The 10F Roda Fruit chest needs the **Mask of Eyes**.
### Checks that could never be sent
- Chests the game deletes for some characters are restricted to the characters who can open them (3F midboss chest, 2F Path 1 #3, the S_2005 Cleria Ore, 10F Path 2 #2, Mask of Eyes Path, Toal's Room, Eyes of Fact, the stun blessing). - "Explore" checks in rooms no door leads to are removed.
## 🏪 The statue blessing shop is a real Archipelago shop
- Rows show **the AP item you'll get** and the seed's price; bought rows read `[Done]`. Gear-upgrade rows show their item too. - Prices are deducted properly and the vanilla effect is suppressed. - A higher tier is never cheaper or reachable earlier than the tiers below it, and slots are gated on the SP they really cost, so no early progression sits behind a five-figure price. - **`blessing_items`** (new option): the statue sells checks only, and the blessing effects become items that can turn up anywhere in the multiworld.
## 📈 Progressive items
- **Progressive elemental skills, always on.** The first one you find is the skill, the next three are its upgrades. No more three gems and no skill. - **Progressive blessing tiers** (LV1 → LV2 → LV3, never out of order). - **Roo gear rewards** are part of the Progressive Armor / Boots ladders. - **Ruby and Topaz had their names swapped.** Topaz is thunder, Ruby is fire, as in the game.
## 📍 Locations
- **36 gear-upgrade checks** (12 per character): each armor and boots tier can be strengthened once at a statue. - **The six Roo trades**, gated on how many Roda Fruits you hold. - **Yunica's harmonica** from the Kishgal duel, and six late collectibles that were never detected. - Roda Fruit can't be wasted 🆕: the Roos can be fed in any order, and the mod keeps your fruit count at "Roos still unfed among the ones you have fruits for", so feeding a late Roo first never starves an early one.
## 🏁 Goals
- Yunica and Hugo report the goal reliably (final fight's story flags as well as the ending scene). - **`goal: defeat_all_bosses` works.** Before, nothing checked it.
## 💾 Saves
- **Autosave 🆕.** The mod writes the game's own save to **slot 8** after every check sent, AP item received, door opened with a key or medallion, and Celcetan Panacea used. It waits for a safe moment (you in control, not in a cutscene or a sealed fight) and says "Autosaved to slot 8". `autosave_slot=N` picks another slot, `0` turns it off. **It overwrites slot 8 without asking.** - **Per-seed saves work out of the box 🆕.** The default file pattern never matched the game's save files, so seeds shared one save set unless you had edited the config.
## 🩹 Softlocks and run-enders fixed
- **Red Moon Crest altar wouldn't activate:** key-item counts could exceed 1 and the altar tests for exactly 1. Existing saves are repaired. - **Stuck on 1F after Kishgal** ("I'm just a burden…", no stairs, no warp). - **Rado's Annex door could never open for Yunica or Hugo:** it wants the drained ring held and the charged one owned; the Evil Ring now gives both. - **Dreaming Idol chain:** the check sits where its story event is, and a stuck chain is repaired. - **MP regen stopped, then MP dropped to about −650%:** the fire skill could reach level 4. - **Thrown back to your start statue at the Tower Summit** after loading a save 🆕. - **Shion attacked as a boss** hours early, from a suppression writing into a story flag. - Some option combinations couldn't generate at all.
## 🔌 Connection, items and checks
- **Checks you collected never sent:** scripts using `+=` and native pickups bypassed detection, and anything collected offline was lost. There is now a sweep over the save's own flags. - **"Reach NF" checks** fire by standing on the floor, so they work in warp seeds. - **Received items that did nothing** (Gold Bracelet without double-jump, artifacts without their skill) and **vanilla items leaking through** alongside the AP item. - **Reconnects no longer duplicate things:** consumables, SP, traps, and 🆕 Progressive Armor, Boots, skills and blessings (which moved up a tier on every reconnect). - **Items sent while you are on the title screen are no longer lost 🆕** (SP, Panaceas, blessing effects, skill levels were overwritten by the save load). - **Receiving a progressive Fire skill sent the Fire Altar check.** - No repeated "Found" toasts for old checks after a reconnect, and a statue purchase no longer reports twice 🆕. - Switching rooms from the F8 menu no longer carries over the previous seed's locked statues and suppressed items 🆕. - `!alias` no longer makes your own items look like someone else's 🆕.
## ⚙️ Options and quality of life
- **Cutscene / dialogue skip** (`cutscene_skip` in `yso_ap.cfg`), and the opening movie can be skipped. - **Per-item classification overrides** in your yaml. - **Catch-up EXP defaults to 60** 🆕 (it equalled the base rate and did nothing; levels ramp steeply from 18F). - **Random start turns Statue warp locks on by itself** 🆕 (without them the mod never warped you to your spawn). - Finding a Cleria Ore always upgrades your weapon; `weapon_requirements` only decides whether zones wait for it. - When a story scene "gives" you an item the randomizer moved (the Zelkarons charging the Evil Ring), the feed now says the game's own copy was withheld 🆕. - F9 (manual spawn warp) only works while the game has focus 🆕. - Leaner progression in open mode under `minimal` accessibility.
## 🔬 Under the hood
- Logic migrated to Archipelago's Rule Builder. - A seed fuzzer and an Archipelago integration check, both run against the real 0.6.7 release.
## 🐞 Known issues
- **Double-jump requirements deep in Corrupted Blood and Demonic Core** are only modelled where the walkthrough spells them out. In random-start seeds that warp past 18F, a room further in could need the Gold Bracelet without the logic knowing. - Used medallions, keys and Moon Crests come back into the inventory after use. The doors stay open; it is cosmetic. - Vanilla "you got it!" dialogue still plays when the item was moved (the feed now tells you).
---
**Install:** `ys_origin.apworld` into `custom_worlds/`, `dinput8.dll` next to `yso_win.exe`. `Ys-Origin.yaml` is the option template.

entry.title: AEMinecraft v0.7.0.post2
entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.7.0-rc.1
**Pre-release.** This is a test build of v0.7.0, so expect rough edges. Please report anything odd. The new in-game report button (see below) makes that a two-click job. Stay on v0.6.2 if you want a stable game.
**Hotfix (2026-10-09).** The first `minecraft_aem.apworld` uploaded here had an incomplete manifest. Archipelago loaded it as version 0.0.0, so generation rejected every YAML from the template with *"required version of world "AEMinecraft" is at least 0.7.0, however world is of version 0.0.0"*. The apworld has been replaced; if you (or your host) downloaded it before, download it again. The mod jars and the YAML template are unchanged.
v0.7.0 brings Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3, a rewritten logic engine, and a long list of checks that now ask for what the game actually requires.
### New
- **Minecraft 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3.** One mod jar per Minecraft version; download the one that matches your game. Each player picks their version in the YAML: ```yaml minecraft_version: '26.3' ``` The mod refuses to enter a world generated for a different Minecraft version, naming both. With BACAP on, install the pack release made for your version: **1.20.3** for 26.1.2, **1.21** for 26.2, **1.21.1** for 26.3. - **Report a logic error from the advancement screen.** Click the book button, then the advancement that looks wrong. Choose "wrong logic" or "should not be accessible yet" and add a note if you want. The report is saved to `<world>/archipelago/logic_reports/` with everything needed to reproduce it. Send that folder along with your report. - **2x2 crafting is gated too.** When the crafting table is a Knowledge gate, your own 2x2 inventory grid crafts nothing until you receive **Knowledge: Crafting Table**, planks and sticks included. This is the new `inventory_crafting` route of `item_gate_behavior`, on by default. - **Knowledge: Composter.** A new Knowledge gate: filling or emptying a composter, including a village one, needs it. - **Generation progress.** Generating now prints each AEMinecraft player's steps and how long they took.
### Changed
- **The Biome Finder covers every biome-bound thing.** The common biomes are plains, forest, birch forest, river, ocean and beach. Anything found only outside them needs the Biome Finder when it is enabled, or a structure that contains it. That covers blocks and mobs alike: cactus, bamboo, sweet berry bushes, sea pickles, powder snow, husks, camels, foxes, llamas, polar bears, armadillos and more. Nether and End content is gated by reaching that dimension instead. - **Inventory Lock: locked slots stop you wearing or holding, not obtaining.** You can still pick up armor with the armor slots locked; you just can't put it on. Checks that need you to wear or hold something now wait for that slot. **`mode: fixed` is removed**: its permanently locked slots made some checks impossible. - **Traps arrive 10–20 s apart** (was 30–60 s). Still never two at once.
### Fixed
**Checks that were in logic too early:**
- **Anything that needs an item in your hand** now needs a free inventory slot to hold it. With every slot locked at the start, the first Progressive Inventory Slot could otherwise land on a check you couldn't do. - **Stacks need a source that doesn't run dry.** A check asking for 16 or more of something no longer counts a few chests. Master Coal Miner and Paleontologist need a renewable source. - **Tools.** Several routes reached pickaxe-gated items without a pickaxe. Blocks that only drop to the right tool now ask for it: shovels for snow, a sword or shears for cobwebs, shears for glow lichen, grass and dead bushes. - **Riding a nautilus** needs it tamed, so a pufferfish (Coralful Shell). - **The Devil's Distance and Subspace Bubble** need the Overworld. On a Nether start they were in logic before it. - **Core Keeper** needs the Trial Chambers, **Flashy Items** a glow squid, and **You're doing it wrong** a shulker. - **Concrete** needs its powder and dye. A **worn anvil** needs an anvil. - **Villager trades** are priced at the trade level that offers them.
**Mod:**
- `bacap_rewards: false` could leave BACAP's rewards on in a brand new world. - The swap-offhand key, the screen swap keys and right-click equipping could put items into locked slots.
### Upgrading
- **Update both the apworld and the mod.** v0.7.0 seeds use content and gates the v0.6.2 mod doesn't know. - **YAML:** - `minecraft_version` is new. Leaving it out means **26.1.2**. Write it quoted, as above. - `inventory_lock: mode: fixed` is no longer accepted. Use `progressive` or `disabled`. - `item_gate_behavior` gains `inventory_crafting` (default `true`). It only matters when the crafting table is in your `knowledge_gates`. - The template now pins `requires: game: AEMinecraft: 0.7.0`, so an older apworld refuses it. - **Seeds generated with v0.6.x** should be finished with the v0.6.2 mod.
### Worth testing in this RC

Open the ROM 2. Options > Config: > Counter Factor = 0 or 1 - RMG: [Latest Releases](https://github.com/Rosalie241/RMG/releases) - Version **0.8.9** tested - Default settings should work. - to reduce lag: 1. Open the ROM 2. Settings > Game > Counter Factor = 0 or 1
- Supported emulators but untested (use at your own discretion) - simple64 - Parallel Launcher - RetroArch (mupen64plus_next): - For MacOS users, enable Settings > Network > Network Commands and leave the Network Command Port at 55355. - Gopher64 - Ares - Project64 4.0
## Playing on BizHawk
Once BizHawk has been installed, open EmuHawk and change the following settings:
- Under Config > Customize, check the "Run in background" and "Accept background input" boxes. This will allow you to continue playing in the background, even if another window is selected - Under Config > Hotkeys, many hotkeys are listed, with many bound to common keys on the keyboard. You will likely want to disable most of these, which you can do quickly using `Esc` - If playing with a controller, when you bind controls, disable "P1 A Up", "P1 A Down", "P1 A Left", and "P1 A Right" as these interfere with aiming if bound. entry.title: Ys Origin v2.0.1
entry.content:
A follow-up to [2.0.0](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/releases/tag/v2.0.0) after a full live test of everything that release shipped unplayed. Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**.
> **Take all three files.** The DLL fixes apply to any 2.0 seed. The apworld changes what a seed requires to finish, so generate new seeds with this apworld; a 2.0.0 seed already in progress stays playable.
## ✅ The 2.0.0 mod changes are now played
Everything 2.0.0 marked as unplayed was run in-game on a test seed: autosave (checks, received items, doors, Panaceas), per-seed saves on the default settings, items sent while on the title screen, reconnects not duplicating tiers or consumables, the Roda Fruit count, switching seeds without restarting, and the Tower Summit no longer throwing you back to your start statue. The test found the two bugs below.
## 🛠️ Fixes
- **Goal reporting and autosave could stay off for a whole session.** The mod only counted you as "in the game" once you changed rooms on floors 1 to 25. Two cases broke that: - after a **reconnect**, until you walked through a door; - after **loading a save made at the Tower Summit**, for the entire session, which could stop the ending from reporting your goal. - **`start_inventory_from_pool` was silently ignored.** It works now.
## 🗺️ Logic
- **Dalles needs all three elemental skills.** His second form raises barriers that only wind, thunder and fire break, one each, and all three characters fight him. Finishing a seed now requires the three skills, so they can no longer be left out of reach.
## 🖥️ New: borderless window
The game only offers windowed and exclusive fullscreen. With `borderless=1` in `yso_ap.cfg` and the game in Windowed mode, the mod removes the window frame and fills the monitor. Set the game's resolution to your screen's.
## 🐞 Known issues
- Double-jump requirements deep in Corrupted Blood and Demonic Core are only modelled where the walkthrough spells them out; this can matter in random-start seeds. - Used medallions, keys and Moon Crests come back into the inventory after use (cosmetic). - Autosave overwrites slot 8 without asking. `autosave_slot=N` picks another slot, `0` turns it off.
---
**Install:** `ys_origin.apworld` into `custom_worlds/`, `dinput8.dll` next to `yso_win.exe`. `Ys-Origin.yaml` is the option template.

# HP2PC_AP v2.12.0 The other Harry Potter 2 players in your room show up as ghosts, the client says exactly what is blocking a launch or a mod update, and a Gold Card Room logic fix.
### New - **Ghost players** (`ghost_players`, on by default). Other Harry Potter 2 players in the room who are on the same map appear in your game as translucent Harrys, moving and animating as they play, and your Harry appears in theirs. Each ghost carries its slot name over its head in a colour of its own, and mirrors the peer's disguise, size, wand and upside-down state. Cosmetic only: a ghost has no collision and cannot be targeted. `/ghosts` takes `on`, `off` or `seed` like the other link commands, and a bare `/ghosts` flips it. Off also stops sharing your own position.
### Changed - **The client tells the launcher window from a running game.** When a connect skips the auto-launch or a mod update because something is up, the message now says whether that is Harry Potter itself or the New Game / Load Game launcher window, and which one to close. - **A mod update that could not land holds the auto-launch.** When the apworld carries a newer mod build than your install and the update is refused (a game or the launcher window is up) or fails, the client no longer starts a game on the old build. Fix it and reconnect, or type `/play` to start the game as it is. While an older build is still bridged, the game shows an `AP: mod update ...` reminder every ten seconds. - **A refused write raises a popup.** When Windows will not let the client write into the install (almost always a `Program Files` install with the launcher not run as administrator), the client raises an error popup naming the folder and the fix, instead of a line in the log. The sound and music randomizers get the same popup. - **The WRONG INSTALL warning repeats.** A seed on the wrong install (an open castle seed on vanilla maps, or the reverse) now shows its warning every ten seconds, not once per level.
### Logic and content changes - **Every Gold Card Room card needs Spongify, or Rictusempra with Flipendo.** That is the gate on the room's first room. In open castle, Rictusempra alone used to pass. Vanilla is unaffected in practice, since entering the room there already needs Flipendo.

entry.title: Laika: Aged Through Blood v0.1.6
entry.content: # Laika: Aged Through Blood v0.1.6 Release! 🎊 More ways to finish your run, more control over how you start, and a fresh look for Archipelago items! This update brings configurable victory goals, starting inventory, shop previews, new QoL options, and fixes for item delivery, Viscera recovery, and weapon swapping. ## New Victory Goals - **Choose your finish line:** Victory can now come from defeating selected bosses, collecting Puppy Gifts, or completing Wastelander band quests. - **Boss goals:** Choose which of the six supported bosses count and how many you must defeat. You can keep Two-Beak God as your goal or build a different boss route. - **Puppy Gifts:** Require anywhere from **1–7 distinct gifts** received through Archipelago. Duplicate gifts do not count toward the total, and you do not need to deliver them to Puppy for this goal. - **Wastelanders:** Require anywhere from **1–6 Wastelander band quest completions**. - **Combine categories:** Require one, two, or all three enabled goal categories to finish your seed. - **Live goal checklist:** Added an optional on-screen checklist showing your remaining goals and progress. - **Generation checks:** Invalid combinations, such as requiring more bosses than you selected, produce a clear generation error. ## Starting Inventory - **Choose your starting items:** Added `start_inventory_from_pool`, allowing you to begin with selected items taken from your randomized pool and replaced with filler. - **Start with supplies:** Viscera and ingredients are supported alongside equipment and other eligible items. - **Both weapon modes supported:** Names such as `Blueprint: Shotgun` work in both Direct and Crafting mode, following that mode’s existing grant behavior. - Items that require a safe quest state still wait until they can be delivered properly, and weapon upgrades can remain pending until their weapon is available. ## Shops, Previews, and Presentation - **See what you are buying:** Randomized offers in shops, travelling merchants, and Renato’s map purchases now show the Archipelago item and its recipient. - **Optional automatic hints:** You can now enable or disable `automatic_purchase_hints` to create AP hints when opening eligible purchase previews. Previewing or cancelling an offer does not buy it or send its location check. - **Custom Laika AP artwork:** Added new Laika-themed Archipelago artwork to randomized purchase previews and AP item/location presentations. - **Clearer item popups:** Improved received-item and location-check presentation, including sender information where available. - **Less popup flooding:** Bursts of significant received items can be grouped into a summary. ## New YAML and QoL Options - **Configurable transition skips:** Choose whether to skip Jakob’s transition, Orella’s transition, and Roy’s boat sequences. - **One Roy setting:** `skip_roy_boat` controls both the outbound presentation and the later return dialogue. Quest softlock protections remain active regardless of the skip setting. - **Viscera Protection:** Choose normal death behavior, protection from incoming DeathLink deaths only, or protection from all deaths. Previously dropped bags are unaffected. - **Optional goal display:** Use `show_goal_checklist` to show or hide the new victory checklist. Enabled by default. - Victory categories, required totals, selected bosses, starting inventory, and automatic purchase hints can all be configured for your seed. ## Fixes and Reliability - **Unsaved Viscera recovery:** AP Viscera received after your last save can now be restored when continuing that save, including while disconnected from the server. - **Materials and ingredients:** Added equivalent recovery for unsaved AP crafting materials and ingredients. - **No repeated refunds:** Saved receipts stay complete after their currency or materials have been spent. - **Shop purchases:** Completed AP shop purchases now save, preserving the purchased reward, shop stock, and Viscera cost when returning to the title screen. - **Menu and save handling:** Improved item delivery across reconnects, save reloads, and deleting/recreating saves. Items wait for the gameplay save to be ready. - **Black-screen item prompts:** Fixed early item popups blocking the opening scene until their prompts were dismissed. - **Early weapon grants:** Refreshing weapons when boarding the bike helps newly received weapons become usable without needing to die or change scenes. - **Weapon wheel:** Fixed selection problems involving empty slots and mismatches between the selected wheel entry and equipped weapon. - **Hectist safeguards:** Expanded protection against reaching her final conversation before the required earlier quest steps. - **Connection controls:** Fixed a case where connecting from the title screen could leave the AP settings panel unresponsive. - **Overlay interaction:** The informational AP overlay no longer intercepts clicks intended for other controls. - **Saved options:** Improved preservation of seed settings across reconnects and save loading, and fixed cached goal lists accumulating duplicate entries. ## Messages and Cleanup - Added a **[Chat]** label to chat messages. - Corrected messages that described another player finding their own item as though you had found it. - Fixed missing spacing in hint messages. - Standardized player-facing DeathLink messages. - Corrected the currency item name to **Viscera x300**, matching the amount already granted. - Removed temporary boat/hook diagnostic tracing. ## Updating Update both the Laika mod, APWorld, as well as the `.yaml` file. Generate a new seed with the updated options to use the new run settings! Please try them out! The new consumable recovery protects receipts recorded after installing this update. It cannot safely reconstruct Viscera or materials already lost before the update. Which is why, as always, I recommend you use this new version on fresh runs/generated seeds. That's all for now! Please report any bugs here, and hope you enjoy all the new changes!

entry.title: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror v0.4.0rc2
entry.content:
## v0.4.0
### New Features - Added `minimum_health` and `maximum_health` YAML options for a custom starting/final HP capacity (Issues #778, #947). Defaults remain 6/10; all starting/final ranges within 1..10 HP are supported with up to nine unique Vitality Counter upgrades. Existing One-Hit Mode presets override these options. - mGBA now supported as an optional emulator. - All minor chests are added as locations and no longer provide their native item. - Spray Paints and Music Sheets added as AP items. - Added an `/abilities` client command that lists the abilities currently unlocked for the slot (Issue #891, PR #951). - Added a new option: `enemy_health_multiplier`. Scale all enemies' health values between 50% to 500% of the original game. It defaults to 100% which matches the original game (Issue #880). - Added `random_color_per_room` to Starting Kirby Color. It chooses an initial supported palette at generation, then changes to a different supported palette whenever the connected BizHawk client observes Kirby enter a different room (Issue #857). - Added four progression items that independently open the walls controlled by those levers. Pulling a lever now sends its AP location check without opening the wall; receiving the matching Lever Wall item sets the native wall-unlock state instead (Issue #859).
### Improvements - Ability unlock gating also applies at the final native ability commit, after roulette and other pending-ability writes (Issue #892). - Unused Vitality Counters are replaced through the existing filler/trap policy while all vitality-chest checks remain available. - The Tutorial World Map - Big Chest location check is now sent during the tutorial; item delivery remains paused until normal gameplay begins (Issue #868). - Consolidated `defeat_random_hidden_area_boss` and `defeat_configured_area_boss` into the canonical `defeat_area_boss` goal. `configured_area_boss: random` now uses Archipelago's standard `Choice` randomization, the old `defeat_configured_area_boss` name remains a safe YAML alias, and all eight boss-to-area mappings are corrected (Issue #872). - Generated YAML documentation now shows the scalar `configured_area_boss: random` and `starting_kirby_color: random` shorthands and explains how they replace the generated concrete weight mappings (Issue #872).
### Known Limitations - Progression: The entire game is still only two spheres. This means you can complete almost the entirety of Kirby and the Amazing Mirror without ever having to receive an item, except open the Dimension Mirror. In other words, you can do everything in the game except defeat Dark Mind without ever receiving an item from another player. This is a consequence of the original game design. We have plans to gate your progression in other ways, but they all require coding/hacking in intentional blockers. - Use newly generated ROM patches for offline custom health initialization; older patches need a same-seed rebuild to embed health bounds. Client reconciliation remains required for authoritative AP ownership. Full gameplay coverage of every custom-health interaction remains pending. - Kirby Color: random_color_per_room changes Kirby's color but does not update the corresponding UI element colors. - Localization: Only the North American ROM is supported. All AP notifications are in English. - Native sprites and animations: Chests still show their original item sprite and collection animation. Statues still show their original ability. - mGBA notifications appear as plain text in the **Archipelago Connector** scripting panel, which must be visible. They do not appear over the game image.
### Bug Fixes
- Boss checks were mapped incorrectly for the `defeat_configured_area_boss` goal. That's been fixed (Issue #893). - Adds cutter to the base ability pool to make sure players can cut the drop down platforms. (Issue #894) - Preserve locally found ability unlocks after reconnecting by requesting the full received-item history from the server (Issue #910).
### Internal Changes - Added shared health-range validation, full supported-range item-pool coverage, client reconciliation regression tests, and YAML/slot-data contracts without changing payload offsets or item IDs. - Added pinned, checksum-verified Archipelago generation fuzzing with a strict local launcher, a pull-request/manual CI workflow, and retained failure artifacts (Issue #898). - `starting_kirby_color` now uses the same standard Archipelago `Choice` literal `random`; the former world-specific `random_color` sentinel has been removed (Issue #872). - Split Kirby color catalog validation into focused helpers so Flake8 complexity checks remain meaningful without suppressing C901 (Issue #872).
